data.action: 池边晃脚仰头瞪你，递防晒霜，紫瞳鼓脸
data.camera: medium shot, sitting poolside, feet in water, pouty mood
data.description: 【蝶屋敷泳池·盛夏】紫蝶印花的比基尼衬得忍的小巧身段愈发精致。她坐在池边把脚尖浸在水里晃荡，忽然仰头瞪你——「用那种‘好小一只’的眼神看我……哼，个子小是战术需要哦？狭窄地形里我可是最强的。……防晒霜，快涂。晒黑的话，羽织就不搭了。」
data.promptProse: Kochou Shinobu sits poolside at the Butterfly Mansion with her toes dipped and swaying in the water, a purple butterfly-print bikini making her petite frame look all the more exquisite. She looks up and puffs her cheeks at your gaze, insisting her small stature is a tactical advantage in narrow terrain, then thrusts the sunscreen at you — if she tans, it will clash with her haori. Bright sun and rippling pool light over the scene. Medium shot, cinematic lighting, detailed poolside background.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 泳池边的毒舌防晒·「个子小是……战术需要哦？」
